hero.title:
Marine Engineering Services
Fast, Reliable, On-Time
hero.subtitle: Production documentation, structural calculations, and on-site support for ship design offices, shipyards, and vessel owners

about.title: Experienced Team, Agile Approach
paragraphs: We are a specialized marine engineering team based in Poland, serving clients across Europe. With extensive experience in ship design offices, shipyards, and with ship owners in Poland, UK, and Norway, we understand the demands of marine projects.

Our small team structure means direct communication, faster decisions, and personal commitment to quality. We're available for both office-based documentation work and on-site surveys and supervision.

items.title: Production Documentation
items.description: Complete technical documentation preparation for ship construction and repair projects. Detailed drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation for shipyards and production teams.

items.title: Structural Calculations
items.description: Class-approved structural analysis and calculations for marine structures. Compliance with classification society requirements and marine engineering standards.

items.title: On-Site Engineering Support
items.description: Survey work, site supervision, and technical support during construction, refit, or mobilization projects. Flexible deployment from days to weeks.

items.title: Refit Mobilization Projects
items.description: Specialized engineering for vessel mobilizations including underwater cable fixing operations and offshore support vessel conversions.

items.title: New Builds
items.description: Complete engineering support for newbuild projects from concept to delivery. Design development, class approval documentation, and construction oversight for marine vessels and structures.

items.title: Project Management & Consulting
items.description: Strategic project management and technical consulting for marine engineering initiatives. Budget planning, schedule coordination, and technical advisory services for shipyards and vessel operators.

benefits.title: Fast Turnaround
benefits.description: Small team means quick decisions and faster project completion without corporate bureaucracy.

benefits.title: Flexible Engagement
benefits.description: Available for short-term projects, ongoing support, or emergency capacity. Office work or on-site presence as needed.

benefits.title: Quality Focus
benefits.description: Senior engineer oversight on all deliverables. Class society standards compliance. Zero-compromise on technical accuracy.

benefits.title: Competitive Rates
benefits.description: Lower overhead than large offices, better value without sacrificing quality. Transparent pricing, no hidden costs.

benefits.title: Available for Site Work
benefits.description: Not just office-based - we travel for surveys, inspections, and construction supervision when projects require hands-on presence.

benefits.title: Specialized Experience
benefits.description: Deep expertise in PSV, ferries, and offshore support vessels. Understanding of both design office and shipyard perspectives.
